body: `default` feels off here. The "default" of the properties above refers to "default mode" and "default shape".

```suggestion
	Color color1 = color_picker->color_normalized;
```
Shapes have access to picker's private members.

"%s" is missing here.
In addition, perhaps we should use the values of Color instead of `to_html()`. This will always return "ff" for overbright components.

Why alpha isn't returned by color mode?
Ideally we should avoid checking for specific color mode in ColorPicker, because abstracting it out is their purpose. I only just noticed that we still have such checks, this code needs refactoring.
Intensity is the fourth slider, while alpha is the fifth. It's a bit strange to put alpha into the color_mode and process it as the fourth one.

Alpha depends on color mode though (as seen in the line above), so it needs to be handled by color mode.
Also intensity is the strange one if anything. Alpha is part of the color, intensity isn't.

```suggestion
	Ref<GradientTexture2D> gradient_texture = rgb_texture[p_which];
```
The above definition is unnecessary.
Shouldn't this be `okhsl_cache_once`? You are setting the hsv above.

```suggestion
	_set_pick_color(p_color, true, true); // Because setters can't have more arguments.
```
The naming may be misleading, but it should set hsv_cache_once here. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fce71de41914781a87e5a786a78ca04a22700ae4/scene/gui/color_picker.cpp#L648-L661
